calls.statement:
SELECT tier, is_current, valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' AS open_ended, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from, min(join_date) AS min_join, max(join_date) AS max_join
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_current_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_open_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0)) AS ids_without_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current <> (valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31')) AS flag_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_from > current_date) AS future_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' GROUP BY 1) g JOIN stg_member_updates s USING (member_id)) AS gold_in_staging,
 (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) AS max_valid_from

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold'),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) AS gold_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur JOIN act USING (member_id)) AS gold_active_52w,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale_date,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id=999)) AS gold_home_999
